answer: In an agent market trading umber pigments, zephyr forecasts, and dune survey maps, voting power over shared funds is proportional to tokens locked for 90 days, rather than the number of accounts. Splitting a deposit among a thousand identities adds no votes. To control a majority, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens than all honest voters combined, bearing the purchase cost, price risk, and lost use of that capital.
